reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_mcp** (confidence high). Mercado Libre has a documented OAuth REST API (items, vehicle classifieds publishing, search with restrictions) and an official remote MCP server (mainly devsite/docs tooling).

official_mcp.name: Mercado Libre MCP Server
official_mcp.note: Official remote MCP (Authorization: Bearer <app access token>); docs https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/mcp-server

reason: Mercado Libre's official remote MCP (https://mcp.mercadolibre.com/mcp) plus the OAuth REST API. The item-read adapter (get_listing by MLB… item id, me) is served once as automotive/mercadolibre: item ids carry their site prefix, so the same server reads Brazilian listings. A keyword/category listing search is not documented (Items & Searches, updated 04/04/2025, documents /sites/{site}/search only by seller).
